notLevied.why: 4200: no net wealth tax: Constitution of the Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan (1952, as amended 2016) art. 111: no tax or duty shall be imposed except by law (Constitute Project English text, law/cp_Jordan_2016.txt); no law levies it; tax laws read: Income Tax Law 34/2014, General Sales Tax Law 6/1994, Land Registration Fees Law 26/1958, Real Estate Sale Tax Law 21/1974, Social Security Law 1/2014. convention R5-3k-G (extended in pass 3l to states without a closed list of taxes): the constitution reserves taxes to law and no law in force levies this tax (the state's tax laws read in this build are listed); grade A for the clause (text read), the negative rests on that convention (pass 3l).
